record approvals by digest and each outcome rung Krish reports with its evidence

hand work another engine owns, or work that can run in parallel, to that engine's queue with python growth.py engine handoff acquisition TO --what TEXT --why TEXT, ask Krish the question it prints, and send its message to that engine's session
keep Krish's session links in the private .scratch/engines/sessions.json with python growth.py engine session set, show and clear, and python growth.py engine start acquisition --session LINK

send a report-back from python growth.py engine done to the session that sent the handoff, and record a report-back that arrives
close each session with python growth.py engine close acquisition --learnings FILE, after writing the learnings file in .scratch/engines/
close one of this engine's own records, an inbound handoff included, with python growth.py engine done acquisition ID --note TEXT
